aboutHero.hookSub: Marketing undergraduate with a 3.69/4.0 GPA and hands-on experience across agency client delivery, consumer research, data-driven planning, product ownership, and AI-assisted product development. Applies structured problem-solving through award-winning competition cases, revenue-based media planning, and a student venture that recorded 150 orders and 333,000 impressions. Experienced in practical ownership and cross-functional coordination. Brings fluent working English, hunger to learn, and an AI-first approach to work. Seeking to build a long-term career through growth-oriented marketing roles within technology business. Expects to complete degree requirements and become available full-time in December 2026.
aboutHero.hookLineVi: Xin chào. Mình là Dương Tiên.
aboutHero.hookSubVi: Mình bắt đầu từ Marketing, với công việc trải từ nghiên cứu khách hàng, lập kế hoạch thương hiệu đến triển khai chiến dịch. Khi công việc cần, mình cũng tự xây công cụ: dashboard quảng cáo, website bán hàng và luồng xử lý đơn tự động.

proof.heading: A few things I've worked on

items.title: Listening before planning
items.body: I interviewed Gen Z mothers to help define the positioning for our Kingsport competition proposal. Our team placed first runner-up.

items.title: Getting a launch out the door
items.body: I helped coordinate AEON Beta's launch videos across client, creative and production teams. All 31 were delivered on time and passed QC.

items.title: Running a small business
items.body: Our 13-week university project, Pixself, recorded 150 orders. I led the product and website work and added an automated order workflow.

capabilities.heading: What I bring to a marketing team
capabilities.body: I study Marketing at NEU and work agency-side. That has meant learning both how to make a recommendation and how to get the work done with other people.

items.title: Customer research
items.body: I use surveys and interviews to understand what people buy and why. At Hong Ha, that meant looking at stationery shopping on Shopee and TikTok Shop, then contributing to the digital strategy.

items.title: Working with commercial data
items.body: For La Passion's restaurants, I looked at revenue, peak hours, table turnover and average bills to help recommend advertising budgets. I wanted the spend to have a business reason behind it.
items.tools: Revenue analysis · Budget planning · Campaign reporting

items.title: Brand and creative work
items.body: At VuVer, a longer cold season changed our Valentine campaign. I extended the focus on sweaters and produced the key visual, lookbook and social copy. The team recorded revenue at twice the prior two-month average.
items.tools: Positioning · Campaign concepts · Design and copy

items.title: Making the work happen
items.body: At Red Agency, I coordinate briefs, creative and media teams, production, and reporting. My job includes keeping people clear on what needs to happen next and following through on delivery.
items.tools: Client communication · Cross-team coordination · Quality control

aiPractice.heading: I use AI to build things I can actually use
aiPractice.body: AI coding agents are part of how I work now. The starting point is usually a marketing task I know well enough to describe: what needs checking, what a report should show, or where a manual process gets in the way.

items.title: An ads dashboard for account work
items.body: I defined the campaign checks, reporting requirements and account-team workflow, then built the dashboard with AI coding agents. It brings KPI views, campaign health checks and reporting into one place.
items.imageAlt: Red Agency Ads report with campaign checks and supporting evidence
items.caption: My part: requirements, workflow design and AI-assisted development.

items.title: Less manual order handling at Pixself
items.body: Once the shop was taking orders, I upgraded the website and added an n8n order-processing flow. The team could then focus mainly on fulfillment. This was an improvement to a business we were already running.
items.caption: My part: the website upgrade and order-processing automation.

personalBits.text: Outside work, I play League with my brother and take far too many food photos. More of that below.

approach.headline: Understand before deciding.
approach.subheadline: “Hiểu để yêu thương” is a thought I keep coming back to.
paragraphs: For me, that starts with asking people about what they actually do. At Hong Ha, I ran an online survey about buying stationery. For the Kingsport competition case, I interviewed 20 Gen Z mothers to help define the positioning.
I want to get better at connecting those observations to business decisions: which audience to focus on, what to offer them, and how to tell whether it worked.

reflections.title: Following the weather at VuVer
paragraphs: When the cold weather lasted longer than expected, I extended the Valentine campaign's focus on sweaters and produced the key visual, lookbook and social copy.
The campaign helped deliver revenue at 2x the prior two-month average. It was a team result; my contribution was the campaign direction and creative work.

reflections.title: Listening to 20 Gen Z mothers
paragraphs: For the Kingsport case in Digital Creatory 2025, I ran 20 in-depth interviews with Gen Z mothers and used the findings to help define the strategic opportunity and positioning.
Our team placed first runner-up. This was a competition proposal, rather than a launched client campaign.
